title: Add flashlight indirect-light controls
objective: Add a small, explicit runtime control for co-located flashlight indirect lighting so small interiors do not take on a room-wide tint from saturated nearby objects.
instructions: Inspect examples/flashlight/run.py and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py for the spawned ASpotLight / USpotLightComponent setup.

Add CLI support to control the spawned spotlight's indirect lighting contribution, preferably via an --indirect-lighting-intensity float option applied to both teleop and orbit collection workflows if both spawn the co-located light.

Keep defaults conservative for active illumination: avoid room-wide indirect color bounce by default unless the existing project pattern clearly requires preserving current behavior. Document in code/README only if the file already has adjacent option docs; keep docs small.
Do not change unrelated behavior, do not commit, and do not run Unreal or long simulator jobs.
constraints: Tower user explicitly disallows commits unless prompted.

artifacts: cafeteria_500sqft visual complaints are not import/cook failures: the generated scene uses decorative window panes without wall openings, Blender AREA lights are lost by the static-mesh import path, validation disabled all scene lights, and chair backs are placed toward table centers.

For small generated interiors, the current camera flashlight defaults of intensity 30000 and attenuation radius 1200 cm can make Lumen/dynamic indirect lighting bounce the color of the directly illuminated object across the whole room.

expected_outputs: Changed files list and exact command(s) to test the reduced-indirect flashlight manually.
Whether the option applies to run.py, run_orbit_collection.py, or both.
definition_of_done: The user can run the flashlight in the cafeteria with lower intensity/radius and indirect contribution disabled or controlled from CLI.
